metadata.description: Catch your AI coding agent's mistakes before they ship. Guardrails for Claude Code that keep the agent on your rules, ask before destructive commands run, and check its code for security and privacy problems. Runs locally; an optional workspace needs an API key.

plugins.name: lintsure
plugins.description: Checks the code your agent writes against OWASP Top 10, OWASP LLM Top 10, CWE Top 25, GDPR, the EU AI Act and the EU CRA, and guards each edit and command. Runs locally; nothing is sent unless you add an API key.
